name: runtime-execute
description: E3 executor pipeline. resolve_clow (openclaw_resolve_clow) DERIVES the executor runtime via fn_resolve_runtime (direct_llm/openclaw/hermes — capability-availability, no hardcoded default), admits the clow (fn_admit_clow, fail-loud), and resolves the model (aisha_resolve_clow_backend, serviceable-filtered). dispatch (runtime_dispatch) then EXECUTES the work through the derived RuntimeAdapter and journals it (ai_decisions). node_type is free text and the graph is JSONB, so this is pure wire-up over registered nodes — no DB migration.
